fee_notes: No traditional royalty or marketing fund percentage of gross sales disclosed. The primary ongoing fee is an Advertising Fee of 15% of the purchase price of Maui Wowi Products and Maui Wowi Supplies and Equipment (not a % of gross sales; represents approx. 1%-2% of recommended sales price of a typical smoothie or coffee). Optional Snack Program Fee: $150/month. Technology Fee: $99.95/month. Data Fees: up to $75/month. POS System Software, Maintenance, Support, and Upgrade Contract: $129/month (Permanent Site only). Management Fee (if franchisor assumes management): 6% of gross sales plus direct out-of-pocket costs. Gift Card Redemption Fee: 5-11% of gift card redemption amount (monthly; not currently charged but may be in the future). Additional per-event and penalty fees also disclosed (training, annual meeting, transfer, renewal, default, late report, audit, NSF, collection, relocation, document administration, surcharge up to $10/week for NY-located franchises, non-participation fee $100/day, sublease late charge 5% of late amount, early termination damages formula-based, lease guarantee fee 10% up to $10,000).
raw_excerpt:
Advertising Fee (Note 1 and Note 2): 15% of the purchase price of Maui Wowi Products and Maui Wowi Supplies and Equipment. Payable at the time of each purchase. This fee represents approximately 1% to 2% of the recommended sales price of a typical smoothie or coffee.
Optional Snack Program Fee (Note 1): $150 per month. Monthly.
Technology Fee (Note 1): $99.95 per month. Monthly.
Additional Persons Training Fee (Note 1): $1,250 per person.
Additional Training Fee (Note 1): $300 per person per day.
Annual Meeting Registration Fee (Notes 1 and 5): $1,000 for one or two to attend; additional $500 if you do not attend; additional $500 for each additional attendee beyond two.
Training Cancellation Fee (Note 1): $500.
Depository Account: $3,000 (must be replenished on a regular basis).
Data Fees (Notes 1 and 6): Up to $75 per month.
POS System Software, Maintenance, Support, and Upgrade Contract (Note 1): $129 per month.
Renewal Franchise Fee (Note 1): 25% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee.
Transfer Franchise Fee (Note 1): 25% of the then-current and applicable Initial Franchise Fee.
Relocation Fee (Note 1): $500.
Transfer Training Fee (Note 1): $2,500 for two individuals ($500 for each additional individual).
Document Administration Fee: $500.
Default Rate (Notes 1 and 8): (a) Prime Rate plus 4%; or (b) 18% per annum, or the highest permissible rate.
Late Report Fee (Note 1): $100 per report.
Sublease Late Charge: 5% of the late or unpaid amount plus any late charges and interest under the Master Lease.
Collection Costs (Note 1): All collection costs including reasonable attorneys' fees.
Non-Sufficient Funds Fee (Note 1): $50 for each electronic funds transfer returned; $25 for each check or draft returned.
Audit (Note 1): Cost of Audit plus interest at Default Rate on underpayments.
New Supplier Approval Fee (Note 1): Not to exceed the reasonable cost of inspection and actual cost of test, not to exceed $5,000.
Non-Participation Fee for Fixed Operating Unit (Note 1): $100 per day.
Early Termination Damages (Note 1): Greater of (A) average monthly Advertising Fees, Snack Program Fees and Technology Fees for any consecutive 12-month period within the preceding 48 months multiplied by months remaining divided by 2, or (B) number of Mobile Units x $5,000 and/or Fixed Operating Units x $10,000 divided by 12 multiplied by months remaining divided by 2.
Management Fee: 6% of gross sales plus direct out-of-pocket costs.
Gift Card Redemption Fee (if applicable): 5-11% of the amount of the gift card redemption. Monthly.
Lease Guarantee Fee (optional): 10% of the total amount guaranteed, up to a maximum of $10,000.
Reimbursement of Taxes: Cost of all taxes, assessments and similar charges incurred arising from operation of Franchised Business.
